messages:
emma_cs: Heads-up — NimbusPay just submitted a bespoke SIG/CAIQ pack asking for KMS/HSM rotation evidence, audit-log retention proof, and a writeup for a March token exposure. Due EOD Tue. Link: https://portal.nimbuspay.com/request/4281. cc @sam_sec @jordan_engineer

sam_sec: On it. Can you paste the exact questions? I pulled the doc but want to triage scope.

emma_cs: Copied Qs: 1) KMS key rotation schedule and proof, 2) HSM attestation, 3) audit log retention policy + export for March, 4) incident timeline/root cause/mitigations and a signed statement. They want upload-ready artifacts (screenshots/CSV/pdf).

jordan_engineer: Do we have tenant-scoped audit exports for NimbusPay (tenant id nimbus-77)? If not we should generate an evidence bundle. @li_infra can you run a query and export?

li_infra: I'll export audit events for nimbus-77 for 2025-03-01..2025-03-31 and key rotation records. Running: ```gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.project_id="redwood-prod" AND jsonPayload.tenant_id="nimbus-77"' --limit 10000 --format json > /tmp/nimbus-audit-mar.json``` Will scrub sensitive fields and upload. ETA ~45m.

sam_sec: Also need current HSM attestation — we have vendor cert at /vault/certs/hsm_attestation_2025.pdf. I'll fetch and redact internal IPs and serials. Quick question for timeline: did support revoke the compromised token immediately and rotate keys when detected? @emma_cs

emma_cs: Yes — support rotated the affected API key and revoked active sessions on 2025-03-12 15:21 UTC per ticket #INC-2025-034. Customer liaison confirmed remediation. I'll attach ticket excerpt.

li_infra: Export finished. Uploaded bundle to s3://redwood-sec-evidence/nimbuspay/2025-03_audit_bundle.zip. Public-style link (internal): https://s3.aws.redwood.red/nimbuspay/2025-03_audit_bundle.zip :lock:

sam_sec: :eyes: I'll pull the bundle and assemble the security pack. Need a concise 2-3 line 'what happened' paragraph for the SIG answers and one sentence about mitigations. Emma, can you draft?

emma_cs: Drafted: "On 2025-03-12 a misconfigured third-party deployment exposed a short-lived API key. Upon detection we rotated keys, invalidated sessions, applied configuration guardrails, and initiated an internal post-mortem. No customer data exfiltration was detected." Thoughts?

jordan_engineer: Looks good. Add that we added detection alerts and a policy to forbid public object ACLs on customer buckets to prevent recurrence.

sam_sec: Perfect. I'll attach the HSM attestation (redacted), the audit export, the ticket excerpt, and Emma's paragraph. Also they asked about retention — we retain audit logs for 13 months by default; Dedicated/Private customers can request extended retention. Use that phrasing in the SIG answer.

emma_cs: Sending to NimbusPay now. Uploaded the evidence bundle to their portal and asked if they need signed letterhead. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

opsbot: File uploaded to NimbusPay portal by emma_cs at 2025-06-15T14:12:03Z — portal ref 4281.
